Definition: from a derivative of G2380 (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.
BiblicalUsage: thymiáō stands behind the English phrase to offer incense. In Luke 1:9, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: A priest chosen by lot to burn incense in the temple tells me ordinary duty can be the doorway to extraordinary news from God.
